note: One row per HoMM3 object id that a translated map draws nothing for (or draws the wrong thing for). The census (map_object_presentation.py census) finds the draw-nothing ids; tools/validate_map_object_presentation_contract.py fails the build when a census id has no row here. Causes: dropped_in_raw_translation = the substitution map returns no Olden Era SID, so nothing is emitted and only the invisible homm3_pathing_blocker gap fill seals the HoMM3 non-visit cells (visit cell open, function gone); wrong_native_standin = emitted as an unrelated native object; partial_standin = part of the object is emitted, the building is not; removed_after_substitution = a mapped object deleted by a later pass. Statuses: fix_in_source_pending_regeneration (the source rule is fixed and names expectedSid; the translated maps still need regenerating), delivered (the census shows it drawn), decision_needed (no native object with the same behaviour; options listed), accepted_not_drawn (deliberate, reason given). Native evidence: Core.zip DB/objects_logic (source/static).
